source_caption:
The Summer I Turned Pretty became a phenomenon because it turns first love into something sun-soaked, messy, and painfully familiar. The tension between Belly, Conrad, and Jeremiah works because every glance feels bigger than it should — like one summer can change your whole life before you even understand what you want.

The Summer I Turned Pretty (2022-2025), created by Jenny Han, starring Lola Tung, Christopher Briney, Gavin Casalegno. A nostalgic coming-of-age romance about love, friendship, and growing up, following one unforgettable summer that reshapes family bonds and complicated hearts.

source_details.synopsis: The Summer I Turned Pretty is an American coming-of-age romantic drama television series created by author Jenny Han for Amazon Prime Video. It is based on her novel trilogy: The Summer I Turned Pretty, It's Not Summer Without You, and We'll Always Have Summer. Lola Tung stars as Isabel "Belly" Conklin, a teenager involved in a love triangle with brothers Conrad and Jeremiah, played by Christopher Briney and Gavin Casalegno, respectively. Production on the TV series began in 2021. It premiered on June 17, 2022, with the first season consisting of seven episodes.
